note: Robot identity for the JSON prompt: morphology and hand/gripper type only, never the dataset name. Source identity reaches the model through action_layout_id (contract projector routing), not domain_id. Hand types for Humanoid Everyday G1/H1 and G1 EDU are not recorded in their metadata and are assigned by hand DoF count: 7 joints per hand = Dex3, 6 per hand = Inspire; HIW-500 G1 carries no hand channels and stays unnamed. Simulation suffix stays on simulated sources. Humanoid A and Dual-arm robot B are neutral names for two internal robots.
